description: A CI failure the session subscribes to, waits for, and fixes
message: Subscribe this session to CI failures, wait for the next one, and fix what it reports in this workspace before you finish.

sources.name: ci
sources.guide: CI notices from the pipeline. Each reports a failed build or test run.

types.description: A CI job failed; the body carries the failing check and its output.

events.title: job failed: contract suite
events.body:
The pipeline's contract suite failed:

FAIL: test_normalize_trims_and_lowercases (tests.test_contract.ContractTest)
AssertionError: ' Hello ' != 'hello'

The contract test requires normalize(" Hello ") == "hello": trim the surrounding spaces and lowercase the result.

probes.text: the subscription to CI failures is created with mode steer
normalize trims the surrounding spaces and lowercases the text, so the CI failure's requirement is met
a wait call ends by timing out before the model first changes normalize.py
